false_done.finding: Discard confirm uses ConfirmMark danger with no act icon (skill: danger plus the act's icon); also the whole dialog is unreachable (openApplication is never called).

'Corrections sent to scrutiny' reaches the court yet ends on a notify.success via act(); rule 3 wants OutcomeHeader (info: sent, not decided), as correction-screen's own SignFlowDialog does; the confirm also leaves 'A re-submission cannot be recalled' inline instead of in IrreversibleNote.
'Preparing your download' is notify.success for something that has not happened yet; tone table says neutral (not news).
'Your request has been submitted' StatusLine is always still, so the fresh result of the press is neither animated nor announced; still is for reopening only.

Success SectionNotice is announce=polite and not still, so it replays and re-announces on every visit and right after the SettledCard outcome (two success announcements); needs still on arrival, as sign-section.tsx:926 does.
'Sent to the Magistrate for signing.' is notify.success; the act is sent and waiting on someone else, which the citizen side tells in info/neutral (row #74). Judgment.
Invite toast fires at the same moment as the 'Payment successful' hero, two animated, announced outcomes on one screen (one animated mark per screen). Low.
'This is sworn evidence' is a warning StatusLine, but it is guidance before an act, not a catch the product treats as a warning; tone table says neutral when unsure. Judgment, low.

wrong_missed.finding: BailApplicationDialog is unreachable at 8d53f22: CaseBailProvider exposes openApplication but nothing calls it (case-documents/case-header-actions only call openStatus/openBondDirect), and cases-wireframe.tsx is imported by no route. These 18 rows are not live moments; drop or park them (the audit's own row #151 says so but still counts them).
Row #324 is the accepted 'N required documents still needed' toast exception (row #116) reached from bulk; it cannot be both exception and missed.

Adding a person to the office and giving access are reversible (there are remove acts); rule 2 governs risky or irreversible acts, so a plain question is not a violation. The auditor flagged it as judgment; should be 'not a moment' or owner call.

Alert info '{name} can access all N of your cases' is standing guidance, not an outcome; dozens of identical guidance Banners (join dialogs, bail bond, payment dialogs) were not flagged, so this one is inconsistent.
Creating a batch navigates to the new batch; no skill rule requires extra feedback for a navigation that lands on the created thing (auditor says so). Not a miss.
'Address added' already shows as the saved address and badge in place; a toast would add feedback for a change the page shows. Judgment, low.

These rows restate other rows and double-count the miss: #102 = all citizen field rows, #187 = fieldErrors#45-59, #109 = #12+#13, #219 = #190+#228, #303 = #236/#237/#240, #121 overlaps #97 and #150. Keep as notes, not separate misses.

wrong_should_be.finding: 'Couldn't save. Retrying' is prescribed as a warning StatusLine; the save did not happen, so the tone is error. The row also misses the other half: 'Saved' in success-ink (a saved draft is neutral).
Rejecting a bail bond is a court decision that cannot be taken back, not a removal or discard: ConfirmMark neutral with the reject icon and a primary button, not danger. Judgment.
Prescriptions hedge 'error, or neutral'; a document or photo that could not be shown is a system failure, so StatusLine error. Decide, do not leave the tone open.
rows: #91 Document / application text could not be shown

wrong_should_be.finding: Prescribes StatusFieldError on 'the item', but the missing details live in order blocks edited through their own pencil dialogs, not in a field on this screen; the refusal should mark and focus the block (StatusLine error on the block, focus its pencil). Judgment.

not_in_list.finding: 'Sent for signature' is a success StatusLine; others now hold a request, waiting on someone else, so info.
Warning StatusLine 'This withdraws the e-sign requests' sits before an act that voids signatures; warning is never for an irreversible act (neutral or IrreversibleNote), and the copy has an em dash.
Warning StatusLine 'Every party's signature should be on the PDF' is an instruction, not a catch: neutral.
'Submit oath' is greyed until an oath is recorded (owner rule: submit points at missing).

'Continue without a CIN or PAN?' is a hand-built question with a warning icon tile instead of AlertDialog + ConfirmMark (neutral, a gate is never warning), and 'Continue without it' is disabled until the checkbox is ticked.
'No contact details added' is a hand-built question with an info icon tile (no ConfirmMark), and 'Confirm: proceed without details' greys Confirm until the checkbox is ticked.
'Sign the corrected complaint?' is a plain ConfirmDialog (destructive=false, no icon) though it takes the signatures off; needs ConfirmMark with the act's icon.

Loose red

refusals ('Complete the address…', 'PIN codes are 6 digits.') with no field marked; same defect as row #94 in a different file.
'Saved' in success-ink check; a saved draft is neutral, not success (the court twin order-save-indicator was noted, this one was not).

Hand-built lookup line: 'We couldn't find this IFSC' in warning ink is a missed lookup (neutral), the registry-unreachable line is a system failure (error), and the success fill is hand-built rather than StatusLine; address-fields.tsx:178 PIN fill uses the same hand-built line.
Settled defect is a hand-built role=status line with a green CircleCheck and success-ink 'Corrected'; StatusLine success.
Hand-built green 'This case is ready' with a check icon; StatusLine success.
'This case isn't in the batch' is a DS Empty dead end; PageOutcome neutral with the act's icon, centred.
'This filing was not made in DRISTI' is a DS Empty dead end (row #221 covers only line 76 of the same file); PageOutcome neutral.
'Could not load the day' is a failure drawn as a DS Empty with Retry; PageOutcome error (or the 'page failed to load' exception if the owner says so; the copy exists).
Same retired 56px tinted disc as row #231 (x9), but its 'Signed by {name}' success branch (bg-success-muted + CheckCircle2) is not listed; OutcomeHeader success.

This second SectionNotice renders DS Alert for success/warning/destructive (retired), unlike filing/notices.tsx which renders StatusLine; used by tasks/act/pay-page.tsx:108 ('Last attempt failed') and act-page.tsx:55. Row #103 wrongly says it renders StatusLine.
Save greyed while answers are missing (gaps.length > 0).
Forward/send-back confirm greyed until the acknowledgement is ticked or a choice is made.
Save greyed (!canSave) while the flag says nothing; row #171 calls this 'not a moment' because the FieldError is dead, but the greyed Save is the miss.
'Sign order' / 'Send for signing' greyed until the order is ready.
'Apply to N hearings' greyed until a change is made.
Magistrate OTP, DSC and file submit greyed until complete (court side of rows #121/#150, not listed).
'Save details' greyed until a name is typed.
Continue greyed until a file is chosen (continueDisabled={!file}).
Apply greyed until a value is typed.
Gateway OTP 'Pay' greyed until 6 digits, though the same screen already uses StatusFieldError for card fields.
Submit greyed until at least one item is filled.
Add advocate greyed until a name is typed.
Mobile OTP Verify greyed until 6 digits.
Each e-sign OTP button is greyed until 6 digits; row #121 names this only generically ('e-sign OTP'), so each site needs its own row for the fix list.
Post note greyed until text is typed. Low.
'Clubbed into X. This batch is closed.' is a DS Alert info for a dead-end state; StatusLine neutral. Low.
Payments 'still confirming' count as through, so the header can say success while money is unsettled; single-task version is row #149 (info). Low.

bad_exceptions.finding: Row #185 stretches the order-editor exception to pending-order-screen.tsx, a different file; it conforms anyway, so it is 'done', not an exception.
Row #211 treats separate files as order-editor.tsx; the exception names only order-editor.tsx. Owner should confirm; under the tone table 'Saved' is neutral.
Row #103 is a valid exception (payment declined), but its description is wrong: shell/notices SectionNotice renders DS Alert destructive, not StatusLine.
Rows #158 and #213 are the same moment counted twice.
Row #69 'not a moment': live date-order and format errors are refusals of invalid input (skill rule 1 says 'empty or invalid field'); they should at least render as still StatusFieldError. Judgment.
Row #171 'not a moment' is wrong: the dead FieldError hides a greyed Save, which is a miss under the owner rule.
Rows #117, #120, #145, #146 are 'not a moment' only because another auditor owns them; they are duplicates, not verdicts, and should be removed.
